findings.passage: "Arizonans deserve to know that election laws are not just written in statute but actually enforced in practice," said Senator Hoffman.
findings.note: Quote in a Senate caucus release about his SB 1570 strike-everything amendment, which would have county officials agree with federal immigration authorities to have a federal presence at early voting sites, polling places and drop boxes to prevent violations of voter eligibility laws. The release says federal personnel could not question anyone solely to determine eligibility.

findings.passage: “This is a brand new initiative. So, this is something that the legislators are certainly going to be weighing the merits of. And I look forward to seeing the support that we do have,” Hoffman said.
findings.note: Tucson Weekly page (a reprint of an Arizona Mirror story by Jeremy Duda) quotes him at the launch of a ballot initiative to require ID on early ballots and photo ID in person. He says legislators may weigh referring it to the ballot.
subjects: ID with mail or early ballots

findings.passage: Arizona’s authority to require citizenship means little without authority to verify it.
findings.note: Summary of argument in an amicus brief filed in his name in Mi Familia Vota v. Fontes (the national-committee appeal) (No. 25-1017) supporting the petitioner. He was prime sponsor of HB 2492 (2022). The brief says Arizona may demand proof of citizenship on its state registration form.

findings.passage: An assertion of citizenship and evidence of citizenship do different work.
findings.note: Same amicus brief, argument part I: a signed attestation of citizenship and documentary evidence are treated as separate things, and the brief says the law allows corroboration of the attestation.

findings.passage: The Court should restore Arizona’s authority to verify citizenship and remove noncitizens from its voter rolls.
findings.note: Same amicus brief, summary of argument: asks the Court to allow citizenship verification and removal of non-citizens from the rolls.
